name: app-top-banner
where: a banner across the top of every page; `impersonated` is true when an admin opened the mailbox through an impersonation handoff, `canReturn` when api.user.returnToOwnAccount() can take them back to the account they started from

name: plugin-dialog
where: inside a dialog the plugin opened with api.ui.openDialog (with `anchor: 'trigger'` a popover beside what the user clicked)

name: command-palette
where: entries in the command palette (Ctrl+K)

name: app-side-panel
props: { view: null, context: null, focusRequest: null }
where: a side panel next to Calendar, Contacts, Files and Settings (desktop and tablet; phones and Settings below 1024 px have none: the toggle there asks the plugin for a dialog through onAction, surface `app-side-panel`, actionId `open`, context { view, context }); `view` names the view ("calendar" | "contacts" | "files" | "settings"); `context` is what it shows: { event } (calendar:read), { contact, selectedCount } (contacts:read), { files, fileCount, folder } (files:read), { page: { id, label } }; `focusRequest` counts up when the panel opens on request

name: navigation-rail-bottom
where: the bottom of the navigation rail

name: sidebar-widget
where: a widget at the bottom of the mail sidebar

name: sidebar-section
where: a collapsible section in the mail sidebar, below the folders

name: side-panel
where: a panel beside the mail (list and reader) and beside a plugin's pages (`app-page`, which narrow by its width), opened from its button in the rail at the right edge (Mountain View's side panel; in the default layout a rail of its own, desktop only); the button's title and icon from api.ui.setSidePanel, else the plugin's name, no button with its `rail: false` (then opened by api.ui.openPanel / togglePanel only); the open panel is remembered in this browser; `slots['side-panel'].fill = true` makes the frame as tall as the panel; `focusRequest` counts up when the plugin opened it with api.ui.openPanel('side-panel')

name: sidebar-section-actions
where: compact controls beside a collapsible plugin sidebar-section heading

name: top-bar-actions
where: buttons in the top bar, next to search

name: app-page
where: a full page of its own, with an entry in the navigation rail (api.ui.setPages); api.ui.openPage moves the tab there

name: message-list-header
where: above the message list

name: message-list-empty
props: { mailboxId: null, mailboxRole: null, searching: null }
where: in an empty message list, below the "no messages" text

name: message-row-actions
where: hover buttons on a message row, and its right-click menu (the row menu on phones); the click's `accountId` names the message's account when it is not the user's own (a team or shared mailbox)

name: message-bulk-actions
where: buttons in the toolbar shown while messages are selected

name: context-menu-email
where: the right-click menu of a message

name: toolbar-actions
where: the message toolbar

name: search-results
where: entries a plugin returns from onProvideSearchResults, in a block above a search's message list; a click opens the message an entry names, any other reaches the plugin as onAction with the entry's key as actionId

name: reader-header
where: at the top of the open message, above the subject

name: reader-below-subject
where: right under the subject and sender of the open message

name: email-banner
where: a banner above the message body; `deviceType` ("mobile" | "tablet" | "desktop") says whether the reader has a side panel (not on phones)

name: reader-above-quote
where: between the new text of a message and the quoted text below it

name: email-footer
where: below the message body

name: thread-summary
where: above the messages of an open conversation (the phone conversation view and Mountain View; the default desktop layout opens one message at a time and has no conversation view)

name: reader-actions
where: buttons in the open message's toolbar (its More menu on phones); `accountId` as on message-row-actions

name: email-detail-sidebar
where: a side panel next to the open message; `selection` is the text selected in the message as the user changes it ({ text }); `listSelection` names the messages ticked in the list when two or more are ({ emails: [{ id, accountId }], total }, at most 50, else null); `focusRequest` counts up when the plugin opened the panel with api.ui.openPanel

name: email-details-section
where: a section in the message details

name: attachment-actions
where: buttons on each attachment

name: reader-selection-menu
where: entries in the right-click menu on selected text in a message (without plugin entries the browser's own menu stays); the click's selection is { text }

name: attachment-menu
where: entries in each attachment's menu (for example "Save to Nextcloud")

name: composer-toolbar
where: the composer's plugin row above its bottom bar, for controls that need their own UI (a button belongs in composer-toolbar-actions)

name: composer-above-body
props: { draft: 'email:send', selection: 'compose:read', insertText: 'compose:open', getSelectedText: 'email:send', composerId: null }
where: between the subject and the message text

name: composer-below-body
props: { draft: 'email:send', selection: 'compose:read', insertText: 'compose:open', getSelectedText: 'email:send', composerId: null }
where: below the message text, above the attachments

name: composer-sidebar
props: { draft: 'email:send', selection: 'compose:read', composerId: null, focusRequest: null }
where: a panel left of the composer; `selection` is the selected text of the message as the user changes it ({ text, empty }); `focusRequest` counts up when the plugin opened the panel with api.ui.openPanel

name: composer-sidebar-right
props: { draft: 'email:send', selection: 'compose:read', composerId: null, focusRequest: null }
where: a panel right of the composer, with the same props as composer-sidebar

name: composer-attachment-source
where: the composer's plugin row, next to composer-toolbar, as a source of files (older plugins; an entry in the Attach menu, composer-attach-menu, with api.composer.attach looks like the app's own)

name: composer-send-menu
where: entries in the menu next to Send

name: composer-attach-menu
where: entries in the Attach menu (for example "From Nextcloud"); the click's composerId lets api.composer.attach add files

name: composer-options-menu
where: entries in the composer's Options menu

name: composer-toolbar-actions
where: buttons in the composer's bottom bar, after Attach, Templates and Options; an action's shortcut works while the composer has focus

name: composer-header-actions
where: icon buttons in the composer's top bar, before its own window buttons, in every form of the composer (docked under a message, full, a window of its own, a Pro tab, quick compose); where the bar is narrow they go behind one button that opens them as a menu; the click's composerId lets api.composer.* work on the draft (Bulwark 1.21 and later)

name: composer-selection-menu
where: entries in the right-click menu on selected text in the message (without plugin entries the browser's own menu stays); the click's selection is { text }

name: calendar-event-actions
where: buttons in the event form

name: calendar-event-detail
where: a section in an event's details

name: calendar-event-form
where: a section in the form for a new or edited event

name: calendar-day-header
where: a short label under a day's name in the day, week and month views; a dot in the phone month view (api.ui.setDayLabels)

name: mini-calendar-marks
where: dots on days in the small month calendar (api.ui.setDayLabels)

name: contact-cryptokeys
where: the encryption keys section of a contact

name: contact-detail-section
where: a section in a contact's details

name: contact-list-actions
where: buttons in the contact list toolbar

name: task-detail-section
where: a section in a task's details

name: task-list-actions
where: buttons in the task list toolbar

name: calendar-task-view
where: the calendar's task view (Calendar › Tasks) below its toolbar, in place of Bulwark's task list; the toolbar (filter, new task, task-list-actions) stays; one plugin at a time, the first offering it; `filter` is the toolbar's filter ("all" | "pending" | "completed" | "overdue"), `calendarIds` the calendars ticked in the sidebar; `slots['calendar-task-view'].fill = true` makes the frame as tall as the area below the toolbar, so the plugin scrolls inside it; api.ui.openCalendar({ view: 'tasks' }) opens the view

name: file-actions
where: entries in a file's menu and the selection toolbar

name: file-preview-section
where: a section in the file preview

name: settings-section
where: a section on the plugin's own page in Settings (above its settings-page, when it has one: one entry per plugin)

name: settings-page
where: a page of its own in Settings, listed under the plugin's name

name: admin-plugin-page
where: the plugin's page in the admin dashboard
